# Milesight UG65 Indoor LoRaWAN Gateway

> UG65 is an IP65 indoor LoRaWAN gateway for scalable IoT networks. It integrates an 8-channel half/full-duplex LoRaWAN concentrator, an embedded LoRaWAN Network Server, and connectivity to IoT clouds or BMS platforms over MQTT(S), HTTP(S), BACnet/IP, BACnet/SC and Modbus. Configuration and automation are exposed both through the Web GUI and an HTTP/CGI API.

## Feature areas

- **8-channel LoRaWAN (Class A/B/C)**: half/full-duplex 8-channel LoRaWAN concentrator with LBT; built-in LoRaWAN Network Server; bands CN470 / IN865 / EU868 / RU864 / US915 / AU915 / KR920 / AS923-1&2&3&4; multicast, FUOTA, Noise Analyzer, Gateway Fleet.
- **Protocol servers**: BACnet/IP and BACnet/SC server, Modbus TCP and Modbus RTU server for read/write of building objects.
- **Packet Forward**: multi-destination forwarding, gateway fleet, configurable radios.
- **Edge apps**: Node-RED, Python SDK, Web GUI management.
- **Connectivity**: 1 × GbE with 802.3af PoE PD, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz, optional 4G LTE; VPN (OpenVPN/IPsec/PPTP/L2TP/GRE/DMVPN/WireGuard), SNMP v1/v2c/v3, syslog, PPPoE/DDNS/DHCP, QoS/routing.
- **Battery backup (UG65-B)**: optional UPS battery module shows charge/power status in the Overview page.

- [HTTP & API reference](https://ursalink-resource-center.oss-us-west-1.aliyuncs.com/kevin/llms/ug65/v1/docs/03-http-api-guide.md): authentication (incl. password encryption keys), CGI core/base map, REST endpoints, MQTT/HTTP integration schema
- [Integration guide](https://ursalink-resource-center.oss-us-west-1.aliyuncs.com/kevin/llms/ug65/v1/docs/04-integration-guide.md): LoRaWAN sensor onboarding, MQTT/HTTP integrations, BACnet/Modbus servers, Node-RED, VPN, SNMP
